title: Past Perfect (Pluscuamperfecto)
description: Describe actions that happened before another past action using había + past participle.

grammar.title: Past Perfect (Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto)
grammar.content:
The past perfect describes an action that happened BEFORE another past action. It's the 'past of the past.' You form it using the IMPERFECT of HABER + a past participle.

Imperfect of HABER:
- yo: había
- tú: habías
- él/ella/usted: había
- nosotros: habíamos
- vosotros: habíais
- ellos/ellas/ustedes: habían

Past participles:
- -AR → -ado (hablado)
- -ER → -ido (comido)
- -IR → -ido (vivido)
- Irregulars: hacer→hecho, decir→dicho, escribir→escrito, ver→visto, abrir→abierto, romper→roto, volver→vuelto, cubrir→cubierto
examples: Ya había comido cuando llegaste. (I had already eaten when you arrived.)
Nunca había visto algo tan bonito. (I had never seen anything so beautiful.)
Cuando llegué al cine, la película ya había empezado. (When I arrived at the cinema, the movie had already started.)
Ellos se habían ido antes de que yo llegara. (They had left before I arrived.)
grammar.aid_note: Romanian uses a similar structure: 'avusese' (had) + past participle. The Romanian past perfect (mai mult ca perfectul) is more complex with its own set of endings, but the concept is identical. The Spanish 'había + participle' is much simpler to conjugate.

grammar.title: Present Perfect
grammar.content:
Present Perfect = haber (present) + past participle

Formation:
He hablado (I have spoken)
Has comido (You have eaten)
Ha vivido (He/She has lived)
Hemos terminado (We have finished)
Han llegado (They have arrived)

Past participles:
-AR verbs → -ado (hablado, comido, vivido)
-ER/-IR verbs → -ido (tenido, hecho, dicho)

Irregular past participles:
hacer → hecho
decir → dicho
ver → visto
escribir → escrito
leer → leido
abrir → abierto
cerrar → cerrado
romper → roto
morir → muerto
poner → puesto
volver → vuelto
resolver → resuelto
cubrir → cubierto
descubrir → descubierto
imprimir → impreso

Uses:
1. Actions that happened at an unspecified time:
He estado en Espana tres veces. (I have been in Spain three times.)

2. Actions that started in the past and continue to present:
He vivido aqui desde 2010. (I have lived here since 2010.)

3. Actions just completed:
Acabo de llegar. (I have just arrived.)
examples: He terminado la tarea. (I have finished the homework.)
Hemos comido en ese restaurante antes. (We have eaten at that restaurant before.)
Nunca he ido a Mexico. (I have never been to Mexico.)
Ya he leido el libro. (I have already read the book.)

grammar.title: Past Perfect and Future Perfect
grammar.content:
PAST PERFECT (Pluscuamperfecto):
Haber (imperfect) + past participle

Habia hablado (I had spoken)
Habias comido (You had eaten)
Habia vivido (He/She had lived)
Habianos terminado (We had finished)
Habian llegado (They had arrived)

Uses: An action that happened BEFORE another past action:
Cuando llegue, el ya se habia ido. (When I arrived, he had already left.)

FUTURE PERFECT:
Habra + past participle

Habre terminado para manana. (I will have finished by tomorrow.)
Para 2030, habre viajado por 50 paises. (By 2030, I will have traveled to 50 countries.)

CONDITIONAL PERFECT:
Habria + past participle

Habria venido si me hubieras avisado. (I would have come if you had warned me.)
examples: Cuando llegue, ella ya habia salido. (When I arrived, she had already left.)
Si hubiera estudiado, habria aprobado. (If I had studied, I would have passed.)
Para el ano que viene, habre aprendido espanol. (By next year, I will have learned Spanish.)
Habria venido si me hubieras invitado. (I would have come if you had invited me.)

grammar.title: Subjunctive in Compound Tenses
grammar.content:
PRESENT PERFECT SUBJUNCTIVE:
Haya + past participle

Haya hablado (I have spoken)
Hayas comido (You have eaten)
Haya vivido (He/She has lived)
Hayamos terminado (We have finished)
Hayan llegado (They have arrived)

Uses: After expressions of doubt/will in present:
Dudo que haya llegado. (I doubt he has arrived.)
Espero que hayas terminado. (I hope you have finished.)

PAST PERFECT SUBJUNCTIVE:
Hubiera/Hubiese + past participle

Uses: Unreal past conditions/wishes:
Si hubiera sabido, te hubiera avisado. (If I had known, I would have warned you.)
Ojalia hubiera estudiado mas. (I wish I had studied more.)

Sequence of tenses with subjunctive:
MAIN CLAUSE → SUBJUNCTIVE CLAUSE
Present/Future → Present Perfect
Past → Past Perfect

Espero que hayas venido (present/future main)
Esperaba que hubieras venido (past main)
examples: Dudo que haya terminado. (I doubt he has finished.)
Es probable que haya llovido. (It's probable that it has rained.)
Si hubiera llegado a tiempo, me hubiera tocado. (If I had arrived on time, it would have been my turn.)
No crei que hubieras hecho la tarea. (I didn't think you had done the homework.)

pronunciation.title: Stress in Past Perfect Forms
pronunciation.content:
The imperfect of haber carries stress on the second-to-last syllable:

- había (ha-BÍ-a) — stress on the í
- habías (ha-BÍ-as) — stress on the í
- había (ha-BÍ-a) — stress on the í
- habíamos (ha-bí-A-mos) — stress on the á
- habíais (ha-bí-A-is) — stress on the á
- habían (ha-BÍ-an) — stress on the í

The accent marks on había/habías/habían show where the stress falls. The nosotros and vosotros forms have no accent because the stress falls naturally on the second-to-last syllable.
pronunciation.aid_note: Romanian stress patterns are similar — the auxiliary 'avuse' carries stress on the last syllable, but the concept of marking stress with accent marks is the same in both languages.

exercises.question: The past perfect is formed with:
exercises.explanation: The past perfect uses the IMPERFECT of haber (había, habías, había...) + past participle (hablado, comido, vivido).

exercises.question: Complete: 'Cuando llegué, ya ____ (comer).' (When I arrived, I had already eaten.)
exercises.explanation: 'Había comido' — past perfect: había + past participle comido.

exercises.question: What is the past participle of 'hacer'?
exercises.explanation: 'Hecho' is the irregular past participle of hacer. Used in past perfect: había hecho.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Ella ya ____ (salir) cuando yo llamé.' (She had already left when I called.)
exercises.explanation: 'Había salido' — past perfect of salir: había + past participle salido.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Ellos ya ____ (salir) cuando nosotros ____ (llegar).' (They had already left when we arrived.)
exercises.explanation: 'Habían salido' = past perfect (they had left). 'Llegamos' = preterite (we arrived). The past perfect action happened BEFORE the preterite action.

exercises.question: What is the past participle of 'decir'?
exercises.explanation: 'Dicho' is the irregular past participle of decir. Used in past perfect: había dicho (had said).
